approach: split the zero-vendor result by cause: empty canonical manifest stays AXI #5 (exit 0), an unreadable pre-0.6 layout becomes AXI #6 (structured error, exit 1)
keep the change additive to the frozen build suite so no freeze re-open is needed
rewrite the doctor skill description for layout/upgrade routing without a new spec node — shipped skills are reach artifacts under ADR-0009, deliberately outside the behavioral corpus

why.floor: none — gherkin-cli diff reports 4 added / 0 modified / 0 removed on build.feature; the frozen scenario 'no targets declared is a definitive empty state' is unchanged, so no narrowing and no freeze re-open. Compatibility: the build can newly exit 1 where it exited 0, taken as a minor on a 0.x line and declared in the changeset. Conflict none.
why.blast: small — one existing behavioral node revised (plugin/build), no node added or moved, no other node's contract touched.
why.novelty: low — the change applies the corpus's own AXI contract, splitting a result the node already produced across principles #5 and #6 rather than inventing a rule.
why.confidence: high — cold spec-judge returned ALIGNED true with oracle/builder/architect all pass and no blocker; all four combinations of the closed-form rule are covered by scenarios; 597 package tests green and the field report reproduced end to end against the compiled binary.

note: The pre-0.6 signal set (a top-level vendorExtensions block, a shadowing .plugin/plugin.json) is asserted in two places with no shared home: the plugin/build node's closed-form rule and the doctor skill's finding table. They agree today, but adding a third legacy marker would need both updated with nothing forcing it. Wants one named home for the signal set.

Standing policy question for the doctrine loop: no shipped skill under skills/ carries a spec node, per the root spec's ADR-0009 framing of skills as reach artifacts named in prose. This CR changed a skill description — routing text with real failure modes — outside any gate. Worth deciding whether reach routing text ever deserves a lightweight node.

why.floor: none — no frozen scenario weakened; the four added scenarios all verify, and the untouched empty-state and next-step scenarios were re-exercised against the compiled binary and still hold.
why.blast: small — one branch of buildPlugin, one stderr line in build's CLI, and doctor's recognition of the stopped build; no other command's contract changed.
why.novelty: low — the detection is a pure function handed the one filesystem fact it needs, matching the package's clean-architecture rule.
why.confidence: high — cold impl-judge re-derived each scenario's oracle independently and exercised all four against the compiled binary plus two constructed pre-0.6 git fixtures for doctor; 597 package tests green on the rebased tree.

note: plugin version <bump> calls buildPlugin after the version files are already written, inside one try/catch. On a repository stuck on the pre-0.6 layout the bump now lands and the command then exits 1 on the build step, where it previously bumped and reported success with a nothing-to-build warning. Loud beats silent and the bump is re-runnable, so this is not a regression, but the interaction has no test and no stated position.
